info.title: Chariow API
info.description: The Chariow API allows you to programmatically interact with your digital product store. Manage products, customers, sales, licenses, and more.

get.description: Retrieves information about the authenticated store.
Retrieves a paginated list of published products.
Retrieves a specific product by public ID or slug.

post.description: Creates a new checkout session for a product purchase.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of sales.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by customer name or email

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Filter sales from this date (Y-m-d format)

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Filter sales until this date (Y-m-d format)

get.description: Retrieves a specific sale by public ID.
Retrieves a paginated list of customers.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Filter customers created from this date (Y-m-d format)

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Filter customers created until this date (Y-m-d format)

get.description: Retrieves a specific customer by public ID.
Retrieves a paginated list of issued licenses.
Retrieves a specific license by its key. Use this endpoint to validate a license by checking the `is_active`, `is_expired`, and `can_activate` fields in the response.

post.description: Activates a license on a device.

get.description: Retrieves activation history for a license.
Retrieves a paginated list of discount codes.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Filter discounts created from this date (Y-m-d format)

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Filter discounts created until this date (Y-m-d format)

get.description: Retrieves a specific discount by public ID.
Retrieves a paginated list of webhook notification pulses.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by URL or trigger events

get.description: Retrieves a specific pulse webhook by public ID.
Retrieves affiliate information by their unique affiliate code.

post.description: Sends invitation emails to the provided email addresses. Up to 25 emails can be sent in a single request. Existing affiliates and pending invitations are automatically skipped.

formatted.description: Human-readable formatted amount with currency symbol

quantity.description: Stock quantity information (present only for limited quantity products)

sales_count.description: Formatted sales count (null if hidden by store owner)

fields.description: Custom fields defined for the product (conditional)

bundle.description: Bundle details (present only for bundle products)

custom_fields.description: Custom field values for the product

custom_metadata.description: Custom key-value metadata (max 10 keys, 255 chars per value). Included in Pulse webhook payloads.

customer_ip.description: The buyer's IP address (IPv4 or IPv6). This endpoint is called server to server, so the request IP is your own infrastructure. Forward the buyer's IP here so the sale records it and the buyer's country is resolved correctly.

shipping.description: Shipping address (required for products with shipping enabled)

SaleSummary.description: Sale summary returned in list endpoints (uses SalePublicResource)

SaleDetail.description: Detailed sale returned in show endpoint (uses SaleResource)

masked_key.description: Masked license key for display (e.g., ABC-***-***-789)

is_active.description: Whether the license is currently active and usable

can_activate.description: Whether the license can be activated (has remaining slots)

certificate_url.description: URL to download the license certificate

metadata.description: Custom metadata stored with the license

activated_at.description: When the license was first activated

expires_at.description: When the license will expire (null for lifetime)

customer_email.description: Restricted to this customer email (if set)

is_auto_generated.description: Whether the discount was auto-generated by the system

source.description: Source of the pulse (e.g., manual, zapier, make, n8n)

is_editable.description: Whether the pulse can be edited by the user

Affiliate.description: Store affiliate with nested account structure

source.description: How the affiliate joined (e.g., invitation, network)

emails.description: Array of email addresses to invite (1-25 items)
